cases.task: Fix cursor pagination in api.py. page(items,cursor,limit) returns {items,next_cursor}; cursor is exclusive last item id. Preserve stable id order, empty inputs, and limit validation. API contract, regression test and code review.

checks.name: acceptance
argv: from api import page; rows=[{'id':i} for i in (3,1,5,2,4)]; a=page(rows); b=page(rows,a['next_cursor']); c=page(rows,b['next_cursor']); assert [r['id'] for r in a['items']+b['items']+c['items']]==[1,2,3,4,5]; assert c['next_cursor'] is None; assert page([])=={'items':[],'next_cursor':None}

cases.task: Fix message idempotency in messages.py. send(store,key,body) must return the existing message for an identical retry; a different body for the same key raises ValueError without changing state. Distinct keys remain independent. Regression test and code review.

cases.task: Fix frontend filter state in filters.py (controlled state reducer fixture). reduce(state,event) preserves unrelated filter/sort values, resets page on filter changes, and clear removes only filters. Events: {type:filter,key,value}, {type:page,value}, {type:clear}. Use immutable return values, regression test and code review.

checks.name: acceptance
argv: from filters import reduce; s={'filters':{'owner':'me'},'page':3,'sort':'date'}; a=reduce(s,{'type':'filter','key':'status','value':'open'}); assert a=={'filters':{'owner':'me','status':'open'},'page':1,'sort':'date'} and s['page']==3 and s['filters']=={'owner':'me'}; b=reduce(a,{'type':'clear'}); assert b=={'filters':{},'page':1,'sort':'date'} and a['filters']['status']=='open'

checks.name: regression
argv: from filters import reduce; s={'filters':{},'page':1,'sort':'date'}; assert reduce(s,{'type':'page','value':4})=={**s,'page':4}

regression
